name: Standing Cross-Body March

instructions.description: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your chest lifted and brace your core lightly.
Lift one knee toward hip height while reaching the opposite hand across your body toward the raised knee. Keep your torso upright and avoid collapsing forward or sideways.
Lower your foot back to the floor under control and return your arm to the starting position. Then lift the opposite knee and reach toward it with the other hand.
Alternate sides in a slow, steady rhythm. Focus on controlled knee lifts, balanced weight shifts, and smooth cross-body movements.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.

commentsNotes: Slow the pace or use support if balance is challenged.
Avoid rounding your back or leaning excessively to reach the knee.
Start slowly to establish the cross-body coordination before increasing the pace.

variations.variationDescription: Cross-Body March — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.
